A bank of 952 seeded errors (changed dose, flipped negation, wrong drug, wrong unit, dropped “with water”, invented advice): Chaski caught 183 of 184 and 100 % of the critical ones, and every block names the fact that failed.
Asking Claude “is this translated correctly?” also catches errors, but never says why and holds back 1 in 4 correct sentences.
Full turn, end to end, live: p50 7.8 s, p95 11.4 s; a whole consultation 49–70 s; $0.0084 per turn. Only two Claude roles (interpreter and critic): no agent for its own sake.
